project.name: Rhuddlan Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Local Cadw and National Monuments Record of Wales data and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 19 directly adjoining public green-space geometries and 1 reviewed visitor extensions were included in the active visitor boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Rhuddlan qualifies as a local detour through Rhuddlan Castle and Church of Saint Mary. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Rhuddlan: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Rhuddlan offers Rhuddlan Castle, Church of Saint Mary, Churchyard Cross within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Rhuddlan Castle
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Rhuddlan Castle and Church of Saint Mary, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
